body:
We had waited a week but now we finally had the ten pills of morphine that we had been waiting for.  The whole week I could not think of anything but of how great it would be.  I have always been a fan of pills especailly opiates.  We each took one pill (10mg.) and an hour later we felt very subtle effects of a opium like high. We had three pills left and wanted to use them wisely.  We had crushed one up in a morter and pestle sniffed half the line each.  The sting was not as bad as I thought it would be.
This is where the effects started to hit very hard.  Pure pleasure washed over me.  We sat on the floor completely still not saying a word.  We finally reelized what we were doing and had a short laugh.  My friend began to get naseaous and had pucked twice.  As we had learned with a prior expierence with vicodin when we feel naseaous, we smoke some pot and lie down.
The only way that I can describe it is beautiful nothingness.  There was no future and no past just me.  We finally ended up drifting off to sleep.  The next morning I had an intense headache and felt as though someone had beat my brain with a rock.  After much convincing we decided to smoke the last pill on top of a bowl of some fairly good ganja.  The smoke had a chemical taste to it and the pill was not burning but melting.  We decided that, after two rounds, the smoke was to harsh and to dump the bowl.
I would definetly do it again. My friend had not liked the intensness of it and said if he was to do it again it would be at a much lower dose.  I would definetly take 20mgs orally sometime but where I live these things go as quickly as they come...
